appDescription: Hyun is a passenger-seat conversation assistant that knows the driver's tastes, the current trip and the traffic on the route.

function.name: ASK_HYUN
function.description: Pass the driver's question or request to the Hyun assistant, which answers in its own voice.

question.description: The driver's question or request, in the driver's own words.

function.name: HYUN_STATUS
function.description: Report the current trip status from the Hyun assistant, such as destination, remaining time and traffic on the route.

item.description: Which part of the trip status to report.

function.name: HYUN_QUIET
function.description: Turn the Hyun assistant's quiet mode on or off. Quiet mode keeps only safety alerts and answers.

mode.description: quiet to stop small talk and suggestions, talk to allow them again.
